claim_boundary: This compares the same deterministic SPPA generator under three input contracts. Text-only uses a reviewed tag and no image. Detector modes use real YOLOE text plus declared metric replay; the visual mode adds agnostic image-space cues. It is not 3D ground truth, not measured flight localization, and not a visual SOTA leaderboard.

rows.mode_contract: Reviewed text tag only; no image, bbox, mask, metric replay, or visual cues.

rows.label: biker
rows.mode_contract: Real YOLOE detector text plus declared metric replay/observation fusion; no visual part cues.
rows.prompt: biker from YOLOE detector text plus declared metric observation

rows.mode_contract: Real YOLOE detector text plus declared metric replay, agnostic image-space primitive cues, and conservative observed material color.
